						🚨 SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025 Result 2026: Out Now!

						The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the official notification for the SSC Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) 2025 (Non-Technical) & Havaldar (CBIC & CBN) Recruitment 2025, starting tomorrow, June 26, 2025. The online application window is open until July 24, 2025 (11:00 PM). Eligible candidates can apply at https://ssc.gov.in. Eligibility: MTS and Havaldar require a 10th (High School) pass from a recognized board. Physical Standards for Havaldar: Walking - Male (1600m in 15 min), Female (1km in 20 min); Cycling - Male (8km in 30 min), Female (3km in 25 min); Height/Chest - Male (157.5cm, 76-81cm), Female (152cm). Age Limit (as on August 1, 2025): 18-25 years for MTS, 18-27 years for Havaldar, with relaxation per rules. Application Fee: Rs. 100 (General/EWS/OBC), free for SC/ST/PWD and all females, payable via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking. Pay Scale: Rs. 5200-20200 + Grade Pay Rs. 1800 (7th CPC Pay Matrix). Selection Process: Tier-I, Tier-II, Document Verification, and Final Merit List. Check trending Delhi updates for application tips. #SSCMTS2025
